$comment: The phone-first V1 screen and state inventory for issue #76. Every state names the authorized data it is drawn from, whether the pinned release's runtime already produces it (existing), has the data or operation but not this presentation or one sub-feature (partial), or needs something the release does not have (proposed), and the gap in words. The prototype in design/v1-phone/ renders every state from a labeled synthetic fixture with the same id; design/tools/v1-phone-check.mjs holds the two together. A PROPOSAL, not owner-approved, and not a shared contract.

runtimeLevels.existing: The pinned release already produces this state from this data. The design changes how it looks and is laid out, not what it says or when.
runtimeLevels.partial: The release has the data and the operation, but not this presentation or one part of it. Frontend work only; no contract or backend change.
runtimeLevels.proposed: Needs something the release does not have: a contract field, a backend answer, a new capability or an owner decision. Labeled PROPOSAL wherever it is drawn.

dataSources.local: This device's own input and command flow: not authoritative, never stored beyond what the release already keeps.
dataSources.session: matches/{id}/control/session, read by the host only (readHostSession): matchId, roomCode, playerCount, status.
dataSources.lobby: matches/{id}/lobby/public (FullLobbyView): status, seats[seatId, initialRoom]. Readable by admitted members; the host is admitted as a display member.
dataSources.admissions: matches/{id}/admissions/{admissionId}: uid, status pending|approved, initialRoom, seatId, requestedAt. The host lists all; a requester reads its own.
dataSources.identities: matches/{id}/identities/public (crew-0.1.0): seats[seatId, displayName, characterId], locked. Public.
dataSources.setup: matches/{id}/setup/public (staged-start-1): stage lobby|choosing|awaiting-ready|running|aborted, choosingEndsAt, readingEndsAt, seats[seatId, confirmed, ready], dealId. Neutral; no role.
dataSources.setupPreview: matches/{id}/setupPlayerViews/{uid} (FullSetupPlayerView): dealId, bindingRevision, self.role. The own role only, readable only by the current binding during awaiting-ready.
dataSources.playerView: matches/{id}/playerViews/{uid} (FullPlayerView, protocol 2): the public facts plus self, knowledge, legalTargets, ownPendingCommandIds, ownBallot, hasVoted, hackPartnerSeatId.
dataSources.publicView: matches/{id}/views/public (FullPublicView, protocol 2): round, phase, activeSeatId, seats, ballot, lastTally, result, endReveal.
dataSources.acknowledgments: The seat's own acknowledgments document (OwnAcknowledgments): supplierResults, receivedSupply, historyAvailable.
dataSources.serverTime: v1ServerTime samples calibrating a monotonic local estimate. A countdown is an estimate and never ends a window.
dataSources.receipt: The answer to this device's own operation or command: accepted/registered, rejected (PHASE_CLOSED, NOT_ALLOWED), failure codes, or no answer.

components.about: Compact top bar: wordmark, surface word (HOST, PLAYER, DISPLAY) and the connection chip. 44 CSS px tall at most; never holds an action that matters.
The screen's title as a slanted comic caption in the approved caption yellow. Live text; wraps rather than truncates.
Fixture or emulator label. Never shown for a live match.
Reconnecting / stale / unreadable update. Stays in view above the content.

The one primary action of the screen, in the thumb zone. At least 4rem tall (token component.dockMin), 44 CSS px controls, env(safe-area-inset-bottom). Inline at the end of the content on desktop and when the keyboard is up.
Ink-bordered comic buttons. Primary is amber (press this). Danger is paper with an ink hatch and the word; never red, which is a team color.

components.hook: PROPOSED .j-chip[data-kind] (setup: choosing, confirmed, reading, ready, bot, waiting)
components.about: A word in a shape. Confirmed and Ready are a solid ink chip with a check glyph; waiting states are dashed. Color is never the only difference.
A server-timed window as seconds in an ink box and a bar that empties. At zero it only changes the words to waiting for the server. Unsynced shows –:–– and says so.
One line about what just happened to this device's request. Problem and uncertain notices carry a glyph and a heavier border, not only a color.

components.hook: PROPOSED dialog.j-sheet (bottom sheet, modal, focus kept inside)
components.about: A bottom sheet for a less frequent public task: share, recovery codes, the display, ending the match. Never holds anything private; the private card has its own sheet.
A collapsed row for a less frequent host tool, with its current state in the summary ("Practice bots · 3 bots").
Three large entry tiles that map to the existing routes. The device identifier moves behind Details: only a display needs it.
7, 8 or 9 seats as three radio tiles. Replaces the select of the release; same request.

components.hook: PROPOSED .j-code (aria-label spells the code) + Copy, Share
components.about: The 12-character room code in three groups of four, monospaced, at least 1.75rem. Copy uses the clipboard; Share and a QR join link are PROPOSALS.
One slot per seat in seat order: the numbered token or the chosen character, the name once set, the starting room, Bot, and the setup chip. Never anything private.
A request to join: the device tag the requester also sees, the room they start in, the free seat to give them, Seat, and the kept-request controls.
Fewer / more bots with the count between them and one Add, Update or Remove control. Bots fill only free seats; human seats are never removed.
Neutral progress of the two setup windows: how many have confirmed a character or pressed Ready, and who is still choosing or reading. No role, faction or device.
While a match runs: round, phase, whose turn and the countdown from the public view, and the host's tools. The host identity is already admitted as a display member, so it may read the public view.
A one-time seat recovery code in groups for reading aloud, with its seat, its expiry and Take it off this screen. Shown from memory only; never in an address or storage.
The identifier the shared display shows, typed or pasted, and Admit the display.
Two presses to end a match. Focus lands on the way back; the control that ends the match is not where the first one was.
The room code entry: 12 characters, uppercase as typed, grouped visually, inputmode text, autocomplete off.
Room A or Room B, as two radio tiles with each room's art and caption. The choice is made before roles and has no role restriction (V1-01).
Where this device stands before setup: request sent, seated, refused, ended. Carries the device tag the host sees, so the two can be matched by eye.
Take over a seat with the match identifier and the host's one-time code. The code leaves the field when the request is made.
Nine character tiles. Available, selected (lifted, check, yellow), taken (greyed, holder's number and name, not offered), confirmed (stamp).
Public name, 1 to 12 characters as the contract counts them (code points). The counter counts the same way.
The confirmed piece as everyone will see it: standee, seat number and name. Public.
The concealed role card. Identical for every role, every seat and every state: no name, color, device or role-specific hook.

components.hook: .ms-role-card--full[data-device][data-character][data-team] inside the open private panel only
components.about: Face up: the player's own character with the role's device added, the role name no larger than a heading, the team word beside a swatch.
The release's concise rule reminder for the role, unchanged words. No match-specific knowledge, target or teammate.
Ready, enabled once the card has been turned up for this deal. Pressing it early is allowed and shortens nothing.
Round, phase and whose turn, with the timer. Sticky at the top of the game screen; stays in view above an open private sheet.
60-second window estimate from server time.
The approved comic page on a phone: Command Room, Room A, Room B, then Hospital and Jail side by side. Fits the width; no horizontal panning.
One room: its art, its caption, its pieces in rows of at most five. Offered rooms are lifted while choosing a move.
The character standee with the seat number and name; public markers on it. The own piece carries YOU.
One line: You, seat, name, location and public status, exactly as everyone sees it.
In the dock: whose turn it is, or that it is yours. Public; says nothing about what this seat can do.
The same neutral control on every phone: Private card. No count, badge or highlight that depends on role, offers or knowledge.
Everything private, opened deliberately: role, what you know, holdings, Supply results and the one action card. Leaves the phase strip in view. Closes on backgrounding.
One sentence per fact the server's view gives this seat. Nothing drawn for what a role lacks.
The Supplier's grant results and a recipient's received weapon, as the release words them.

components.hook: the runtime's one connected action card
components.about: One command at a time: offers, choosing, confirming, submitting, checking, unknown, accepted or registered, not accepted.
An action the server's view opens, its status word and its one control. Not available is said plainly, without a reason the view does not give.
Exactly the seats, rooms or answers the server offers, each a 48 CSS px row with the character, number, name and public status.
What is being voted on now and how many may vote. Never who voted for whom.
The count the server published: a number and a bar per seat, the seat it names, and abstained-or-did-not-vote where the numbers add up.

What changed in public since the last view (health, Jail, Captain, eliminations with the permitted faction reveal), in the sentences the shell already speaks. Derived from two public views only; never from a registration.
The complete text reading path: every seat, name, location and status. Required at 200% text, where a picture cannot grow.
Loading, access, version and recovery screens in the comic frame. States what the server did, never a guessed cause.
How the match ended, as the server names it: a winner, a draw, or ended by the host with no winner.
Every seat's role and the Code, shown only when the finished view carries endReveal. Never for a match the host ended.
The display's identifier, large and grouped, for the host to admit.
The shared display's comic page in two rows, from the public view only.

states.title: Choose Host, Join or Shared display
states.gap: Visual only. The device identifier moves behind Details: only a shared display needs to read it out.

states.title: Create a 7-, 8- or 9-seat lobby
states.gap: Radio tiles replace the select; same request.

states.title: Lobby created: share the room code
states.gap: Layout and hierarchy only. Copy to clipboard is Frontend-only.

states.title: Share sheet: code, link and QR
states.gap: PROPOSAL. Copy is Frontend-only. A join link or QR that fills in the room code is a new convenience: it puts a joining credential in an address (history, logs, screenshots). Needs Integration review; not an existing backend capability.

states.runtimeRef: main.js row(): device tag, initialRoom, seat select, Seat this player → approveAdmission

states.title: Seating answer lost: send the same request
states.runtimeRef: main.js keeping(): Send the same request again / Give this request up

states.title: A request with no free seat
states.runtimeRef: main.js: approve.disabled when no vacant seat
states.gap: Words proposed: say why Seat is unavailable and that lowering the bot count frees a seat.

states.title: Practice bots
states.runtimeRef: practice-controls.js createPracticeControls(): count, Add/Update/Remove bots → setPracticeBots
states.gap: A stepper replaces the select; same request and the same kept-request rule.

states.title: Every seat filled: Start setup
states.runtimeRef: main.js start.disabled unless seated == playerCount, setup open and bots settled → beginSetup

states.title: Character selection progress (30 s)
states.runtimeRef: setup-controls.js createSetupProgress(): countdown, n of N confirmed, per-seat Choosing/Confirmed
states.gap: Confirmed seats show their public character and name from identities (Frontend-only).

states.title: Selection time over: waiting for the server
states.runtimeRef: setup-controls.js: 'Selection time has ended. Waiting for the server…'

states.title: Role reading progress (30 s minimum)
states.runtimeRef: setup-controls.js: n of N ready, per-seat Ready/Waiting for Ready

states.title: Reading minimum over: waiting for named players
states.runtimeRef: setup-controls.js: 'Reading time has ended. Waiting for everyone to be Ready.'
states.gap: Names of the seats still reading are listed (public identities; Frontend-only).

states.title: Match running: status and host tools
states.gap: Frontend: subscribe the host page to the public view for round, phase, turn and timer. No contract change: the host identity is created as a display member (createMatch) and may read views/public once gameplay is available.

states.title: Move a seat to another device
states.runtimeRef: main.js #connected-recovery-*: human seats only, one request at a time → issueSeatRecovery
states.gap: Grouped code for reading aloud. The code is still 43 characters plus the match identifier (finding G20): a shorter supervised hand-over needs an Integration decision.

states.title: Recovery code answer lost
states.runtimeRef: main.js recoveryNote for unsettled / repeated answers

states.title: Ended by the host; start a new game
states.runtimeRef: main.js reads status aborted; 'Forget this match on this tab' then Create lobby
states.gap: Frontend: one New game control that forgets this tab's match and opens Create. It always creates a fresh match with a new room code; nothing of the ended deal is reset or reused.

screens.title: Player joining and waiting
notStates: Unknown room, a room that has started or ended, and a device already in the room are one answer from the server (FORBIDDEN from requestAdmission). The phone says so in one sentence and does not pretend to know which.
A full lobby is not refused: the request is accepted and waits. The host sees that there is no free seat (host.no-free-seat).

states.title: Room code and starting room
states.gap: Room tiles replace the select (same request).

states.title: Room code in the wrong form
states.runtimeRef: main.js invalid: 'A room code is twelve characters, 0 to 9 and A to F.'

states.title: No answer: send the same request
states.runtimeRef: keeping('join'…): Send the same request again / Give this request up

states.title: The room cannot take this request
states.gap: Words proposed. One sentence covers all three server cases, which the server does not tell apart.

states.title: Server busy: wait and try again
Waiting for the host to seat you
states.runtimeRef: main.js: 'Waiting for the host to seat you.' listening to the own admission
states.gap: Shows the device tag the host sees and the starting room (both already on the page; Frontend-only). A request left pending when the host starts setup without it is never closed: PROPOSAL to Integration (see handoff).

states.title: Seated: waiting for the host to start
states.runtimeRef: main.js: 'Seated. Follow the setup steps below.' + setup progress 'Waiting for the host to start setup.'
states.gap: Seat token and roster progress from the lobby (Frontend-only).

states.title: The host ended the match before it started
Take over a seat with a recovery code
states.gap: Reached from a link under the join form instead of the same page.

states.title: Recovery answer lost: asking the server
states.runtimeRef: main.js WAITING_FOR_AN_ANSWER; settled by whether the lobby can be read

states.title: No seat was given to this device
states.runtimeRef: main.js 'The server has not given this device a seat in this match…'

states.title: Choose a character and a public name (30 s)
Character picked and name typed
states.runtimeRef: aria-pressed on .crew-option; Confirm enabled for 1–12 characters

states.title: Taken characters
states.gap: The holder is shown as number and name when the name is known (Frontend-only).

states.title: Confirmed: waiting for the deal
states.runtimeRef: #crew-status 'Character confirmed. Roles are dealt when the selection timer ends.'

states.title: That character was just taken
states.runtimeRef: CHARACTER_TAKEN: 'That character was taken. Choose another.'
states.gap: The tile turns taken in place and the name stays typed.

states.title: That name is taken
states.runtimeRef: NAME_TAKEN: 'That name was taken. Choose another.'

states.title: Uncertain answer: send the same choice
states.runtimeRef: 'The answer is uncertain. Send the same choice again while selection is open.'

states.title: Time is up: the server assigns
states.runtimeRef: 'Selection has ended. The server is assigning any remaining characters.'

states.title: Assigned automatically at expiry
states.runtimeRef: The reveal stage shows the role card on identity.characterId
states.gap: Frontend-only: say 'chosen for you when time ran out' when this device had not confirmed before the deal. Uses only the public identity and the device's own memory.

states.title: Dealing: the role has not arrived
states.runtimeRef: role-confirmation.js 'Waiting for a fresh, authorized role.'

states.title: Dealt, face down
states.runtimeRef: #setup-role-toggle 'Reveal my role'; Ready disabled until revealed

states.title: Face up: role, device, guidance
states.runtimeRef: renderComicRoleCard + ROLE_GUIDE inside #setup-role-card; Hide my role; Ready
states.gap: Large card, as approved (DSN-D19 does not apply here: setup has no actions to keep in reach).

states.title: Ready before the minimum
states.runtimeRef: #setup-ready-waiting 'You are ready. The match starts after the reading timer and everyone’s confirmation.'

states.title: Uncertain Ready: send it again
states.runtimeRef: 'Your Ready answer is uncertain. Send the same request again.'

states.title: Minimum over: waiting for named players
states.gap: Names from the public identities (Frontend-only).

states.title: Everyone Ready: waiting for the minimum
states.runtimeRef: 'The first turn waits for 30 seconds of reading and everyone’s Ready.'

states.title: Connection lost while reading
states.runtimeRef: Feeds quarantine on hidden; role concealed; no stale banner in setup
states.gap: Frontend: the connection banner in setup, the card forced face down, the countdown dashed. Never a redeal or a pause promise.

states.title: Seat moved to this device: Ready again
states.runtimeRef: role key = dealId/seat/bindingRevision; a new binding must Ready
states.gap: Words proposed for why Ready is asked again.

states.title: Back from the background: hidden again
states.gap: A one-line note proposed.

states.title: Reference: the nine role cards
states.gap: A review sheet, not a screen: each card is what one seat sees, privately.

states.title: Someone else's turn
states.runtimeRef: renderComicPlayerShell: .ms-board (comic zones), phase strip, closed private panel
states.gap: Layout: board first on one screen, strip sticky, private dock at the bottom (DSN-D04, DSN-D18).

states.title: Private card open: role, knowledge, offers
states.runtimeRef: ConnectedPrivateAreaModel content: role, knowledge, actions card (idle offers)
states.gap: Presented as a bottom sheet below the sticky strip (Frontend).

states.title: Move: choose a room
states.runtimeRef: Move offers self.movementDestinations as a list
states.gap: Pressing an offered room on the board is DSN-D18 (proposal); the list stays complete and is the fallback at large text.

states.title: Confirm before sending
states.runtimeRef: confirming step; armed delay on the new control

states.title: Registered: not a result
states.runtimeRef: acceptedTarget + acceptedDetail ('This is not a result…')

states.title: Move accepted; the piece moves on the public fact
states.runtimeRef: moved(destination); comic-motion.mjs plays the 900 ms move from the public location change

states.title: Not available (spent or not offered)
states.gap: No reason is given that the view does not carry; nothing is drawn as spent (DSN-D02).

states.title: Result unknown: check again
states.runtimeRef: unknown + unknownDetail; cannot be put away

states.title: Choice withdrawn by a new view
states.runtimeRef: choiceDropped 'Your choice was not sent.' when the view no longer offers it

states.title: Supply results (the Supplier's phone)
states.runtimeRef: comic-shell.ts own-acknowledgments: 'Your Round 3 Supply granted one weapon each to …'

states.title: A weapon received from Supply (a recipient's phone)
states.runtimeRef: comic-shell.ts: 'You received one ordinary weapon from Supply in Round 3.' and knowledge 'Ordinary weapons you hold: 1.'

states.title: Nine seats, seven in one room
states.gap: Pieces wrap into rows of at most five; tags alternate heights; full names in the readable list.

states.title: Captain election
states.runtimeRef: VotePanelModel current; VOTE with legalTargets.VOTE + Abstain

states.title: A second election among tied candidates
states.gap: The word 'runoff' is not used: nothing in a view says an election is a second one (finding G13).

states.title: Jail vote: casting a private ballot
Ballot recorded: not a result
states.runtimeRef: votedFor + acceptedDetail; own ballot from ownBallot

states.title: Hack conversation (a participant’s private card)
states.runtimeRef: phase HACK; hackWith(seat) inside the open private panel only

states.title: Round resolved: what changed in public

states.gap: Frontend-only: show those same diff sentences as a visible 'What changed' panel at the start of the next phase, with the permitted faction marker ('Revealed: Red'). Derived only from two public views; never from a registration, a pending command or a private result.

states.title: Captain
states.gap: The Captain marker says nothing about immunity (DSN-D10).
